_about: Team-version audit (p82): who may call what. Classes: P public; T own token; S any signed-in user, own account or own data (filtered by owner); R any signed-in user may read (nothing secret), only the admin changes; M member of the project (read, or write where the note says); A admin only. Not read by the app: tests/test_team_route_classes.py keeps it in step with the real endpoints.
